<subject>URGENT - REQUIRES IMMEDIATE ACTION - EnerVista Solutions Orientation tomorrow @The Hanse Grand</subject>
<body>
Date: Thursday, 23.01.2025

Location: The Hanse Grand Hotel, Hamburg

Orientation will be split into two sessions and divided by alphabetical order. Sessions will run 10:00–13:00 and 14:00–17:00.

We encourage all of you to attend your designated session as valuable information will be presented, and you will have the opportunity to get answers to your questions.

You will need to bring your Nordwind Energie AG ID card or driver's license.

You can speed things up tomorrow by filling in the attached forms – alternatively you can complete them there tomorrow.

10:00 Session   Letters A–K  
14:00 Session   Letters L–Z

Registration will be outside of the Elbe Room.

Bus Transportation

Buses will depart from the Ilias Wagenknecht area on the ground floor of the north building at:

First session               Second session  
8:45–9:00                   12:45–13:00
</body>
